title: The Holy Boy (IS2026)
synopsis:
When Sergio, a teacher tormented by his past, is transferred to Remis, a secluded village known as the happiest town in Italy, it seems the perfect place for a new start. But behind the town’s joyful facade lies a dark and disturbing secret. Each week, villagers gather to meet Matteo, an introverted 15-year-old they say is an angel whose embrace can free one of all pain and sorrow. Yet Sergio’s attempt to save Matteo awakens the darker side of the community, and the boy everyone calls the angel of Remis.


Venice Film Festival: FEDIC Award for Best Film
Fantastic Fest: Audience Award, Next Wave Best Director Award

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
飽受創傷困擾的體育老師Sergio調職至一座被譽為意大利最幸福快樂的偏遠小鎮，期盼一個嶄新的開始。然而純樸的表象之下， 他跟隨村民的步伐，發現鎮上每週都會聚集膜拜一名15歲少年，相傳透過他的擁抱，便能洗滌所有痛苦和哀傷。Sergio的出現讓少年能暫時卸下「神職」，做回一個普通學生，卻同時讓全村隱藏的駭人秘密蠢蠢欲動。少年那縷彷彿被天使吻過的白髮下，究竟承受着怎樣的陰影？這場救贖，又將如何「治癒」每個人？


威尼斯影展 FEDIC最佳電影

美國奇幻電影節 觀眾票選獎、最佳新導演獎

cast: Michele Riondino, Giulio Feltri, Romana Maggiora Vergano, Paolo Pierobon, Roberto Citran
